title: Clap switch shor mein kyun fail hota hai? 👏 #shorts
description:
Clap switch fan ke shor mein bhi on-off kyun hota hai? KY-038 sirf loudness dekhta hai, taali nahi.
Is short mein dekho andar ka electret mic, LM393 aur pot.
🎤 Electret mic awaaz ko voltage banata hai
⚙️ LM393 comparator threshold se compare karta hai
🎚️ Pot se sensitivity set hoti hai
💡 Tip: do taali ek second ke andar gino
🔔 Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D ke liye
#shorts #KY038 #Arduino #ClapSwitch #ElectronicsHindi #DIY #Makers #SoundSensor
tags: clap switch kaise kaam karta hai
thumbText: Sunta nahi, hawa ka dabaav naapta hai
